#
# Every Arch package a CI job in .github/workflows/ci.yml needs, in one place.
# .github/ci/Dockerfile bakes this list into the CI image, and
# .github/ci/sync-packages.sh installs whatever a job's checkout lists that the
# image it runs in does not, so a pull request that adds a dependency here is
# built with it before the image is rebuilt.
#
# One package per line; `#` starts a comment. The draft-PKGBUILD job does not
# read this: makepkg resolves the real dependencies from packaging/.
#
# The shell tier (BUILD_PHOSPHOR_SHELL) is not built in CI, so its
# configure-time requirements (libpipewire, polkit-qt6, pam, ddcutil) are not
# here.

# Toolchain
base-devel
git
ccache
mold
cmake
ninja
extra-cmake-modules

# Qt 6
qt6-base
qt6-declarative
qt6-tools
qt6-shadertools
qt6-svg
qt6-wayland

# Wayland
wayland
plasma-wayland-protocols
wayland-protocols

# KDE Frameworks and KWin (the USE_KDE_FRAMEWORKS=ON leg)
kwin
kconfig
kconfigwidgets
kcmutils
kglobalaccel
kcolorscheme
kirigami
plasma-activities

# Rendering
vulkan-headers
vulkan-icd-loader

# Test-time tools: xvfb and mesa (llvmpipe) for the tests that need a display
# or a real GL context, cava and ffmpeg for phosphor-audio. The shader tests'
# glslang is not here: on x86-64 the configure fetches the release
# cmake/PhosphorDependencies.cmake pins and puts it on those tests' PATH.
xorg-server-xvfb
mesa
cava
ffmpeg

# Lint: clang ships clang-format; qmlformat comes with qt6-declarative.
clang
